lead_raw_text:
The LaSi₂ structure (La₄Si₈ per cell) adopts the tetragonal space group I-4m2 (No. 119), with 12 atoms in the unit cell distributed over three independent Wyckoff orbits. Geometry-derived coordination analysis shows La centers surrounded by 12 Si neighbors, while Si centers have 9 neighbors (4 La, 5 Si), with neighbor distances from 2.7501 to 3.6999 Å. The periodic neighbor graph forms a single three-dimensional component spanning all 12 sites. Validated polyhedron contacts reveal corner-, edge-, and face-sharing between 9-vertex Si polyhedra and between 12-vertex La polyhedra, plus corner- and edge-sharing between La and Si polyhedra.
